filter_pdb_train_mmcifs: run the script to filter mmCIF files and curate the AlphaFold 3 PDB training dataset
filter_structure_with_timeout: filter a single mmCIF structure file with a timeout constraint and write the filtered output
remove_clashing_chains: remove clashing protein chains from a bioassembly where >30% of atoms are within 1.7 A of another chain
remove_hydrogens: remove hydrogen atoms and optionally water residues from a protein structure mmCIF object
filter_large_ca_distances: filter out protein chains with consecutive C-alpha atoms more than 10 A apart
